description: This Java class 'StoreLanding' serves as an entity representing store landing page descriptions in the admin module of a sales management web application. It encapsulates a list of 'StoreLandingDescription' objects with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: StoreLanding
classes.description: An entity class holding a list of descriptions for a store landing page, supporting validation.

methods.description: Setter method for the descriptions list.
